notes.en: HSC GPA out of 5.0 accepted directly. PAL required for study permit. Mandatory CLB 7 for PGWP upon graduation.
CGPA out of 4.0 from recognized Bangladeshi university. GRE/GMAT required for top tier. Exempt from PAL cap. Retains spousal work privileges and 3-year PGWP.
PAL required. Effective Nov 1, 2024, PGWP eligibility tied to 900+ labor shortage fields of study and CLB 5 language score. Spousal work permit excluded.
Thesis supervisor approval required. Fully funded packages common via assistantships and external scholarships. Exempt from PAL cap.

moiConditions.en: MOI certificates from Bangladeshi institutions are generally rejected by IRCC and Canadian DLIs. Standardized tests (IELTS/PTE/TOEFL) are required.

notes.en: Gaps over 6 months require clear explanations. Master's gaps must be backed by verifiable employment (bank-paid salary, tax returns). Gaps over 2 years post-HSC heavily increase undergraduate visa refusal risk.

cost.upfrontDepositLabel: Guaranteed Investment Certificate (GIC) / 1st Year Living Fund Deposit

meritThresholdNote.en: Automatic entrance scholarships trigger at HSC GPA 4.80+ or A Level AAB+ (CAD 1,000 - 10,000 waiver). Full ride options are extremely rare.

named.name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
named.coverage: Full tuition, living expenses, books, and incidental fees for 4 years (100%)

notes.en: Undergraduate applicants must plan for full self-funding. Research-based graduate students receive assistantships (TA/RA) covering tuition plus stipend.

work.coversWhatShareOfLivingCost: Covers 50% - 65% of living costs; cannot pay for tuition fees.
work.dependantWorkRights: Spousal Open Work Permit limited to spouses of students in Master's (16+ months), PhD, or professional programs. Excluded for college diploma and undergraduate degree spouses.

restrictions.en: College graduates must graduate from a labor shortage field of study and achieve CLB 5. University graduates require CLB 7 in language test.

pathwaySteps: Obtain 1 year TEER 0, 1, 2, or 3 skilled Canadian work experience
Submit Express Entry CEC or Provincial Nominee Program (PNP) profile
Receive ITA and apply for Permanent Residence

mainRisk.en: High Express Entry CRS score cut-offs (500+), temporary resident volume reductions, failure to meet CLB 7, or non-skilled employment.

pr.recentChanges: National cap on study permit intake, PGWP field of study restrictions for college programs, CLB 7/5 language benchmark requirements, and restriction of spousal work permits.

visa.name: Study Permit and Temporary Resident Visa

priorRefusalNote.en: Prior refusals must be fully disclosed. Hiding a refusal leads to a 5-year ban under misrepresentation. Refusals require GCMS notes and new corrective evidence.

commonRefusalReasons: Insufficient unverified liquid funds or lack of 4-month bank statement history
Weak ties to Bangladesh and failure to demonstrate intent to depart
Illogical program choice not aligned with academic/career background

bangladeshNotes.en: Requires Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) for undergraduate entry. IRCC heavily scrutinizes land valuation certificates and third-party sponsors; liquid funds in 4-month statements are strictly enforced.
